 const Officer = require("../models/Officer");
 const Token = require("../models/Token");
 
 // ======================================================
+// PUBLIC OFFICE QUEUE STATUS
+// CITIZEN SIDE
+// ======================================================
+
+const getPublicOfficeQueueStatus = async (req, res) => {
+  try {
+    const { tokenId } = req.params;
+
+    if (!tokenId) {
+      return res.status(400).json({
+        success: false,
+        message: "Token ID is required",
+      });
+    }
+
+    // --------------------------------------------------
+    // FIND USER TOKEN
+    // --------------------------------------------------
+
+    const userToken = await Token.findById(tokenId)
+      .populate("governmentOffice")
+      .populate("officer")
+      .populate("service");
+
+    if (!userToken) {
+      return res.status(404).json({
+        success: false,
+        message: "Office token not found",
+      });
+    }
+
+    // Make sure this is an office token
+    if (
+      userToken.tokenType !== "office" ||
+      !userToken.governmentOffice
+    ) {
+      return res.status(400).json({
+        success: false,
+        message: "This is not a government office token",
+      });
+    }
+
+    const officeId = userToken.governmentOffice._id;
+
+    // --------------------------------------------------
+    // GET ALL ACTIVE TOKENS FOR SAME OFFICE
+    // --------------------------------------------------
+
+    const queue = await Token.find({
+      governmentOffice: officeId,
+      tokenType: "office",
+      status: {
+        $in: [
+          "waiting",
+          "serving",
+        ],
+      },
+    })
+      .populate("officer")
+      .populate("service")
+      .sort({
+        createdAt: 1,
+      });
+
+    // --------------------------------------------------
+    // CURRENTLY SERVING
+    // --------------------------------------------------
+
+    const currentToken =
+      queue.find(
+        (token) =>
+          token.status === "serving"
+      ) || null;
+
+    // --------------------------------------------------
+    // WAITING TOKENS
+    // --------------------------------------------------
+
+    const waitingTokens =
+      queue.filter(
+        (token) =>
+          token.status === "waiting"
+      );
+
+    // --------------------------------------------------
+    // PEOPLE AHEAD
+    //
+    // Only count waiting tokens created
+    // before the user's token.
+    // --------------------------------------------------
+
+    const peopleAhead =
+      waitingTokens.filter(
+        (token) =>
+          new Date(token.createdAt) <
+          new Date(userToken.createdAt)
+      ).length;
+
+    // --------------------------------------------------
+    // AVERAGE SERVICE TIME
+    // --------------------------------------------------
+
+    const averageServiceTime =
+      userToken.officer?.averageServiceTime ||
+      currentToken?.officer?.averageServiceTime ||
+      15;
+
+    const estimatedWait =
+      peopleAhead *
+      Number(averageServiceTime);
+
+    // --------------------------------------------------
+    // RETURN QUEUE
+    // --------------------------------------------------
+
+    res.json({
+      success: true,
+
+      office: userToken.governmentOffice,
+
+      userToken,
+
+      currentToken,
+
+      peopleAhead,
+
+      estimatedWait,
+
+      averageServiceTime,
+
+      queue: queue.map(
+        (token) => ({
+          _id: token._id,
+          tokenNumber: token.tokenNumber,
+          status: token.status,
+          source: token.source,
+          counter: token.counter,
+          citizenName: token.citizenName,
+          officer: token.officer
+            ? {
+                _id: token.officer._id,
+                name: token.officer.name,
+                department:
+                  token.officer.department,
+                counter:
+                  token.officer.counter,
+                averageServiceTime:
+                  token.officer
+                    .averageServiceTime,
+              }
+            : null,
+          createdAt:
+            token.createdAt,
+        })
+      ),
+    });
+  } catch (error) {
+    console.error(
+      "getPublicOfficeQueueStatus error:",
+      error
+    );
+
+    res.status(500).json({
+      success: false,
+      message:
+        "Unable to load office queue",
+      error: error.message,
+    });
+  }
+};

+// ============================================================
+// GET CITIZEN'S OWN GOVERNMENT OFFICE QUEUE
+// ============================================================
 
+const getCitizenOfficeQueue = async (req, res) => {
+  try {
+    const userId =
+      req.user?._id ||
+      req.user?.userId;
+
+    if (!userId) {
+      return res.status(401).json({
+        success: false,
+        message: "User authentication required",
+      });
+    }
+
+    // Find the citizen's active office token
+    const myToken = await Token.findOne({
+      user: userId,
+      tokenType: "office",
+      status: {
+        $in: ["waiting", "serving"],
+      },
+    })
+      .sort({ createdAt: -1 })
+      .populate("governmentOffice")
+      .populate("officer");
+
+    // Citizen has no active token
+    if (!myToken) {
+      return res.json({
+        success: true,
+        hasToken: false,
+        data: {
+          myToken: null,
+          currentServing: null,
+          peopleAhead: 0,
+          estimatedTime: 0,
+          counter: null,
+        },
+      });
+    }
+
+    const officeId = myToken.governmentOffice?._id;
+
+    if (!officeId) {
+      return res.status(400).json({
+        success: false,
+        message:
+          "Government office is not assigned to this token",
+      });
+    }
+
+    // --------------------------------------------------------
+    // CURRENTLY SERVING
+    // --------------------------------------------------------
+
+    const currentServing = await Token.findOne({
+      governmentOffice: officeId,
+      tokenType: "office",
+      status: "serving",
+    })
+      .sort({ startedAt: -1 })
+      .populate("officer");
+
+    // --------------------------------------------------------
+    // PEOPLE AHEAD OF THIS CITIZEN
+    // --------------------------------------------------------
+
+    const peopleAhead = await Token.countDocuments({
+      governmentOffice: officeId,
+      tokenType: "office",
+      status: "waiting",
+      createdAt: {
+        $lt: myToken.createdAt,
+      },
+    });
+
+    // --------------------------------------------------------
+    // ACTIVE OFFICERS
+    // --------------------------------------------------------
+
+    const officers = await Officer.find({
+      governmentOffice: officeId,
+      attendanceStatus: "Present",
+      isOnBreak: false,
+      status: {
+        $ne: "Offline",
+      },
+    });
+
+    // --------------------------------------------------------
+    // AVERAGE SERVICE TIME
+    // --------------------------------------------------------
+
+    let averageServiceTime = 15;
+
+    if (officers.length > 0) {
+      const totalServiceTime =
+        officers.reduce(
+          (sum, officer) =>
+            sum +
+            Number(
+              officer.averageServiceTime || 15
+            ),
+          0
+        );
+
+      averageServiceTime =
+        totalServiceTime / officers.length;
+    }
+
+    const estimatedTime = Math.max(
+      0,
+      Math.ceil(
+        peopleAhead * averageServiceTime
+      )
+    );
+
+    // --------------------------------------------------------
+    // SEND RESPONSE
+    // --------------------------------------------------------
+
+    return res.json({
+      success: true,
+      hasToken: true,
+
+      data: {
+        myToken: {
+          id: myToken._id,
+          tokenNumber: myToken.tokenNumber,
+          status: myToken.status,
+          counter: myToken.counter,
+          citizenName: myToken.citizenName,
+          createdAt: myToken.createdAt,
+          startedAt: myToken.startedAt,
+          servedAt: myToken.servedAt,
+          officer: myToken.officer || null,
+        },
+
+        currentServing: currentServing
+          ? {
+              tokenNumber:
+                currentServing.tokenNumber,
+              counter:
+                currentServing.counter,
+              status:
+                currentServing.status,
+              officer:
+                currentServing.officer || null,
+            }
+          : null,
+
+        peopleAhead,
+
+        estimatedTime,
+
+        counter:
+          myToken.counter ||
+          currentServing?.counter ||
+          null,
+
+        office:
+          myToken.governmentOffice,
+      },
+    });
+  } catch (error) {
+    console.error(
+      "getCitizenOfficeQueue error:",
+      error
+    );
+
+    return res.status(500).json({
+      success: false,
+      message:
+        "Unable to load citizen office queue",
+    });
+  }
+};
